action: Grey light. Dressed for work, a cardigan under the jacket. The envelope from Chapter 3 is under the fruit bowl.
Knows line one of the back flap without turning it over. Daniel is in the city.
Makes coffee with aggressive precision. The spoon hits the mug harder than it needs to.
Lifts the fruit bowl, checks the envelope is fully covered, sets the bowl back down. Lifts it again and checks again.
Sarah lets herself in by the back door with a box of her own tea and asks where she can keep it.
Points at the middle dresser drawer, the empty one. Sarah puts the box in.
Sarah asks how the weekend was. The joke about her new project comes out too quick and lands wrong. They hear it land.
cost: Joke regretted and not taken back

action: Sarah: "You don't have to do that." She goes out to wait by the car.
Alone for thirty seconds. Takes the envelope from under the fruit bowl and puts it in the middle drawer, on top of Sarah's tea.
Takes the key off the keyring and locks the drawer. The key goes back on the ring.
cost: Key off the keyring for the first time in nine years

action: Drive in silence with the radio on.
cost: Neither hears the radio; no look out of the window once

action: Pulls up the hotel's website on the phone. Does not call. Clears the browser history.
cost: Clearing the history takes longer than reading the letter would have
